system.longDesc: Swashbuckling. Until the end of your next turn, gain +2 Speed. Incidental actions you take as part of a move action, such as climbing into a ship’s rigging or leaping to swing from a chandelier, don’t consume half your Speed. You may spend additional SP from this test to gain an additional +1 Speed per SP spent. (General Stunt: Positioning) (Cost 2+ SP.)
